_sources._note: Every statutory figure must trace to a primary source: IRS Rev. Proc. / newsroom / form instructions for federal, FTB for California. URL + retrieval date + the keys each source backs.

irs_sch_a_2025_instructions.title: Instructions for Schedule A (Form 1040) (2025)
irs_sch_a_2025_instructions.quote: The overall limit on the deduction for state and local income, sales, and property taxes has increased to $40,000 ($20,000 if married filing separately). The overall limit is reduced if your modified adjusted gross income is more than $500,000 ($250,000 if married filing separately) but will not be reduced below $10,000 ($5,000 if married filing separately).

rev_proc_2023_34_ty2024.title: Rev. Proc. 2023-34 (inflation adjustments for tax year 2024)
rev_proc_2023_34_ty2024.note: Section .03 Maximum Capital Gains Rate: MFJ 94,050/583,750; MFS 47,025/291,850; HoH 63,000/551,350; all other individuals 47,025/518,900. The MFS 15% ceiling had been 259,450 (half of the single ceiling) — corrected per this source (finding F14). Section .11 AMT: exemptions 133,300 MFJ / 85,700 single / 66,650 MFS; 28% bracket at 232,600 (116,300 MFS); phaseout thresholds 1,218,700 MFJ / 609,350 other (complete 1,751,900 MFJ, confirming the 25% rate). Section .27 QBI thresholds 383,900 MFJ / 191,950 other with phase-in amounts 483,900 / 241,950. Section .06 EITC table + $11,600 investment income limit.

irs_topic_409.title: Topic no. 409, Capital gains and losses

irs_pub_501_2025.title: Publication 501 (2025), Dependents, Standard Deduction, and Filing Information
irs_pub_501_2025.note: OBBBA standard deduction for tax years beginning after 2024-12-31: 15,750 single/MFS, 31,500 MFJ/QSS, 23,625 HoH; indexed after 2025.

irs_topic_560.title: Topic no. 560, Additional Medicare Tax
irs_topic_560.note: 0.9% on wages/SE income over $250,000 joint, $125,000 MFS, $200,000 in any other case (incl. HoH and QSS). Statutory, not inflation-indexed.

rev_proc_2024_40_ty2025.title: Rev. Proc. 2024-40 (inflation adjustments for tax year 2025)
rev_proc_2024_40_ty2025.note: sec .06 EITC table + $11,950 investment income limit; sec .11 AMT exemptions 137,000 MFJ / 88,100 single / 68,500 MFS, 28% bracket at 239,100 (119,550 MFS), phaseout thresholds 1,252,700 MFJ / 626,350 other; sec .27 QBI thresholds 394,600 MFJ / 197,300 other with phase-in amounts 494,600 / 247,300.

rev_proc_2025_32_ty2026.title: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 (inflation adjustments for tax year 2026)
rev_proc_2025_32_ty2026.note: sec .03 LTCG; sec .05 CTC 2,200/1,700; sec .06 EITC + 12,200 investment limit; sec .10 AMT (OBBBA phaseout reset to 1,000,000 MFJ / 500,000 other); sec .14 standard deduction 32,200/24,150/16,100 and aged-or-blind 1,650 (2,050 if unmarried and not a surviving spouse); sec .26 QBI.

rev_proc_2022_38_ty2023.title: Rev. Proc. 2022-38 (inflation adjustments for tax year 2023)

schedule_1a_2025.title: Schedule 1-A (Form 1040) 2025 — Additional Deductions
schedule_1a_2025.note: Part II tips: max 25,000, MAGI 150,000/300,000, $100 per $1,000 rounded DOWN. Part III overtime: 12,500/25,000, MAGI 150,000/300,000, $100 per $1,000 rounded DOWN. Part IV car loan interest: 10,000, MAGI 100,000/200,000, $200 per $1,000 rounded UP. Part V seniors: 6,000 less 6% of MAGI over 75,000 (150,000 MFJ).

schedule_8812_2025.title: Schedule 8812 (Form 1040) 2025
schedule_8812_2025.note: Line 10 rounds the MAGI excess UP to the next multiple of $1,000; line 11 multiplies by 5% (= $50 per $1,000).

form_1040es.title: Form 1040-ES, Estimated Tax for Individuals
form_1040es.note: 110% safe harbor applies when prior-year AGI exceeded $150,000 ($75,000 if MFS).

statutory_non_indexed_credits.title: IRS - American Opportunity Tax Credit; IRC 21 and 25A
statutory_non_indexed_credits.note: AOTC ($2,500 max, 40% refundable, $80k-$90k / $160k-$180k phase-out) and the Child and Dependent Care Credit ($3,000/$6,000 expense limits, 35% to 20% between $15,000 and $43,000 AGI) are fixed by statute and are NOT inflation-indexed, so one shared block serves every year.

irs_niit.title: Net Investment Income Tax (IRC 1411)
irs_niit.note: MFJ $250,000; MFS $125,000; single or head of household $200,000; qualifying widow(er) with a child $250,000. NOTE the asymmetry with the Additional Medicare Tax, where QSS takes the $200,000 'any other case' threshold. Statutory, not indexed.

ftb_2025_rate_schedules.title: 2025 California Tax Rate Schedules (FTB)
ftb_2025_rate_schedules.note: Schedule X single/MFS, Schedule Y MFJ/QSS, Schedule Z HoH. Nine brackets 1% to 12.3%. MFJ boundaries are exactly 2x the single boundaries (R&TC 17041).

ftb_2025_form_540.title: 2025 Form 540, California Resident Income Tax Return + booklet
ftb_2025_form_540.note: Line 18 standard deduction $5,706 single/MFS, $11,412 MFJ/HoH/QSS. Exemptions $153 personal/blind/senior, $475 per dependent; line 32 phase-out above federal AGI $252,203. Line 62 Behavioral Health Services Tax = 1% of taxable income over $1,000,000 (renamed from Mental Health Services Tax for 2025). Renter's credit $60/$120 with AGI limits $53,994/$107,988.

edd_de44_2025.title: 2025 California Employer's Guide (DE 44), EDD
edd_de44_2025.note: Supplemental wages: bonuses and stock options 10.23 percent (.1023); other types (overtime, commissions, sales awards, severance, vacation) 6.6 percent (.066). SDI rate 1.2% for 2025 with NO taxable wage limit (SB 951 removed it effective 2024-01-01).

ftb_2025_540es.title: 2025 Instructions for Form 540-ES
ftb_2025_540es.note: Installments are 30% / 40% / 0% / 30% of the required annual payment. CA AGI over $150,000 ($75,000 MFS) uses the lesser of 90% current or 110% prior year. CA AGI at or above $1,000,000 ($500,000 MFS) must use 90% of the CURRENT year — the prior-year safe harbor is unavailable.

state_top_marginal_rates._note: TOP MARGINAL rates for rough estimation only — NOT flat effective rates. Treating CA's top marginal rate as flat overstated CA tax by ~132% at $200K MFJ (finding C1). Use the 'states' block for any state with real brackets.
